<rss version="2.0"><channel><title>Public audit fixture</title><item>
      <title>Claude for Microsoft 365 add-in missing for some users</title>
      <description>
<p> <small>Nov <var data-var='date'>24</var>, <var data-var='time'>01:31</var> UTC</small><br> <strong>Update</strong> - We are continuing to investigate an issue causing the Claude add-in to disappear from Excel, Word, and PowerPoint on Mac for users signed in to Microsoft Office with a personal Microsoft account. In the meantime, we recommend using the web versions of Excel, Word, and PowerPoint at office.com, where Claude remains available for many users. Work and school accounts do not appear affected. We will provide another update as soon as possible. </p> <p> <small>Nov <var data-var='date'>24</var>, <var data-var='time'>00:10</var> UTC</small><br> <strong>Investigating</strong> - We are investigating an issue causing the Claude add-in to disappear from Excel, Word, and PowerPoint on Mac for users signed in to Microsoft Office with a personal Microsoft account. Work and school accounts do not appear affected, and Claude's other apps are unaffected. We will provide an update as soon as possible. </p>      </description>
      <pubDate>Tue, 24 Nov 2026 01:33:45 +0000</pubDate>
      <link>https://status.claude.com/incidents/3vbyqgnswwxq</link>
      <guid>https://status.claude.com/incidents/3vbyqgnswwxq</guid>
    </item></channel></rss>
